name: Butcher
ability: Each day, after the 1st execution, you may nominate again.
setup: Traveller: joins with an alignment chosen by the Storyteller; does not change the base character counts.
interaction: After the day's first execution, the Storyteller prompts the Butcher to nominate again; normal voting rules apply.

rulings.text: The extra nomination needs the normal majority, not more votes than the first execution.
An execution counts even if the executed player does not die.
Exiles are not executions and do not trigger the ability.
The Butcher may nominate an already-nominated player and may retry after failed nominations; a successful second execution does not allow a third.

test_scenarios.name: second execution
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Butcher, Bob Witch, Carol Sage; 7 alive.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 2: Bob is executed; Alice nominates Carol; 4 vote.

test_scenarios.name: retry after failure
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Butcher, Bob Town Crier, Carol Mathematician.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 2: after an execution Alice nominates Bob (fails), then Bob again (passes).
test_scenarios.expected: Bob is executed; Alice cannot nominate further.

test_scenarios.name: execution without death
test_scenarios.actions: Day 2: Bob is executed but survives.
